title: Brain works, but most of its knowledge is still legacy-shaped

evidenceFlow.title: SQLite inventory
evidenceFlow.detail: Read-only counts from live GMS tables.

evidenceFlow.title: File inventory
evidenceFlow.detail: Counted dated Markdown history entries and semantic facts.

metricDefinitions.label: Records
metricDefinitions.definition: Physical rows, facts, graph objects, vectors, or Markdown entries in the named live layer; counts are not additive across layers because the same knowledge may appear in multiple representations.

source.label: Live semantic facts structure profile
methods: Classified every value by native JSON type and attempted JSON-object decoding for string values.

metricDefinitions.label: Structured fact
metricDefinitions.definition: A value represented as a JSON object either natively or inside a decodable JSON string. This is a shape test, not proof that the record satisfies the full context contract.

source.label: Live claims ledger
source.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS claims FROM gms_claims GROUP BY status

source.label: Live context candidate review queue
source.sql: SELECT record_type, review_status, COUNT(*) FROM gms_context_candidates GROUP BY record_type, review_status

metricDefinitions.label: Candidate
metricDefinitions.definition: A schema-valid proposed context record that has not been accepted into current truth; all 11 records had valid JSON payloads and one evidence item.

metricDefinitions.label: Non-generic edge
metricDefinitions.definition: A relationship whose predicate is not configured_as. It measures semantic variety, not correctness.

source.label: Live embedding index coverage
source.sql: SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS chunks, MAX(created_at) AS indexed_at FROM gms_embeddings GROUP BY source

metricDefinitions.label: Indexed chunk
metricDefinitions.definition: One stored vector row for a source chunk. The index contained 297 rows across 16 sources; chunk count is not a count of unique memories.

rows.finding: No accepted records use the new structured context schema
rows.evidence: 0 structured active records; 90 legacy flat records
rows.risk: Agents receive values without consistent rationale, scope, implications, or review conditions.
rows.recommendedAction: Review and migrate high-value records incrementally; do not bulk-promote.

rows.finding: Fixture-like claims remain in the live ledger
rows.risk: Test-shaped assertions can leak into retrieval and look authoritative.
rows.recommendedAction: Preview and remove only the 9 high-signal eligible artifacts, then adjudicate the remaining 9.

rows.finding: The graph is connected but semantically shallow
rows.evidence: 134 of 143 relationships use configured_as; only 9 use specific predicates
rows.risk: Graph exploration appears busy while offering little explanatory or causal structure.
rows.recommendedAction: Extract typed predicates from accepted structured records and project decisions.

rows.finding: The review queue is useful but aging
rows.evidence: 11 proposed candidates created on 2026-09-09; none accepted or rejected
rows.risk: Good AI-curated context remains unavailable to normal retrieval, while users face a growing review backlog.
rows.recommendedAction: Review the 7 decision/policy candidates first, then project state, facts, and lesson.

rows.evidence: Two AlphaOS plugin-version values map to alphaos.swing.plugin.version
rows.risk: Exact lookup can surface competing operational values.
rows.recommendedAction: Resolve with current deployment evidence; preserve the losing value as superseded history.

rows.risk: An agent cannot infer rationale, scope, owner, or next action.
rows.recommendedAction: Repair from source evidence or archive if it has no durable use.

rows.finding: The embedding index is current but concentrated
rows.risk: Large journal coverage may dominate retrieval over curated project and semantic context.
rows.recommendedAction: Track retrieval contribution by source and cap redundant journal chunks during evaluation.

rows.evidence: global-memory bank is 37.9 KB; learning-os 11.1 KB; demo-proj 624 B
rows.risk: Project views can imply equivalent readiness where context depth differs substantially.
rows.recommendedAction: Show completeness and last-substantive-update indicators per project.

source.label: Derived quality findings from live audits

evidenceFlow.title: Convention audit
evidenceFlow.detail: Used memoryctl convention-audit for lifecycle, evidence, fixture, collision, and migration readiness checks.

evidenceFlow.title: Pollution audit
evidenceFlow.detail: Used memoryctl pollution-audit; confirmed pollutants were zero while preserving 18 warning-only suspected fixtures.

evidenceFlow.title: Direct reconciliation
evidenceFlow.detail: Reconciled audit summaries with read-only SQLite and JSON counts.
